rawContent: Here's the link to our *free* online creative writing workshops at @clearlinesuk @StmarysSARC for survivors of rape & sexual abuse. Feb 10 & 12. Led by the fantastic @ShareClaw survivor & poet extraordinaire. @RSLiterature #LiteratureMatters Spaces are limited! #endVAWG #MeToo https://t.co/k0A9YDSdmp

Belfast: City of my rape, but also, city of my recovery. I'm looking forward to speaking at this #free #online conference, Feb 2-3 with the #Belfast organisations that do so much to help victims of rape & sexual abuse @NEXUS_NI @VictimSupportNI #MeToo 

https://t.co/l5QFUJPc8B https://t.co/3p8jSR9mBU

And special thanks to my agent @rcaskie1 and editor @fpathak for bringing this #MeToo story to readers. They've been a delight to work with. @ace_national @TLCUK @SILeedsLitPrize also helped to make this a reality. 🙏🙏🙏🙏

The other exciting news is my writing residency at @shme_bbk kicking off with this #free In Conversation event in 2 wks on Wed, March 3rd. Sexual Violence & Criminal Justice: Approaches in Psychology, History & Literature. Book your spot here 👇👇👇#MeToo #endVAWG

Over 100 tickets book already for our #free event on March 3rd!!!  Great to see so much enthusiasm for this talk. Join us 👉👉 Sexual Violence & Criminal Justice: Approaches in Psychology, History & Literature. #metoo #endVAWG

What would a rape-free world look like? This morning I recorded a fascinating #podcast for @WOWisGlobal with @bourke_joanna @JudeKelly_ & landmark activist Marai Larasi, formerly of @Imkaan @EVAWuk - You'll be able to hear our conversation on #IWD2021 as part of #WOWUK ! #MeToo https://t.co/LAoKmKlPVd

This drops at 5pm TODAY!! For #IWD2021 my @WOWisGlobal chat with @JudeKelly_ @bourke_joanna & Marai Larasi on working towards a #rapefreeworld 💪 Check it out as part of #Wowuk @shme_bbk ! #metoo #endVAWG #IWD21 #iwd

Thanks as ever to @rcaskie1 @fpathak @OrionRights for making Novel No. 2 possible. And to all those who supported & read #DarkChapter (my first, more personal novel about my rape). Looking forward to a #BrightChapter ahead 📚🌟 #MeToo  #endVAWG

#SarahEverard would still be alive if a man hadn’t decided to kill her. End of story. I was violently raped & beaten while walking alone in 2008. I have no illusions that I might be dead if my rapist was more violent or had a gun. That’s the simple truth. End #vawg now. #MeToo

I’m about to speak at #stmarysconf2021 on recovering from my stranger rape & arts communities like @clearlinesuk for survivors. It’s defo the1st time I’ve spoken alongside forensic scientists, but fascinating to hear how DNA samples can track down perpetrators! #endVAWG #MeToo

I’ll be speaking around 8:40 at this fantastic line-up TONIGHT, a global call to action for eliminating #VAWG alongside @JuliaGillard @JudeKelly_ @bourke_joanna @EVAWuk @centreWJ @BonnyTurner1212 & many others! Book to watch for free 👇👇👇 #endVAWG #StopAsianHate #MeToo 💪💪

Susan J Brison is a legend in terms of academic theory on rape, recovery & selfhood. This means so much to me, coming from her 🙏 Come see us in conversation on April 14th! @shme_bbk @clearlinesuk #endVAWG #MeToo #DarkChapter

Finally saw @TheNightingale 😮 Such powerful  #filmmaking but early on there's a brutal, horrific scene so vital to the story. Transcends the 'rape revenge' genre to become a beautiful meditation on the horrors of colonialism & male violence. Gut-wrenching #endVAWG #film #MeToo

Had a great chat with @NEXUS_NI about bringing @clearlinesuk literary talks & #creativewriting workshops for survivors to Belfast this year, thanks to my @ArtsCouncilNI grant. Watch this space for more news! #endVAWG #StrongerTogether #meToo
Looking forward to chairing this panel of amazing writers in 2 weeks' time! #MeToo #endVAWG #StrongerTogether

Over 150 have booked for this free event already! It will be a powerful, authentic conversation. Not to be missed #StrongerTogether #MeToo #endVAWG
https://t.co/pPd5bP7SkU

13 yrs ago today, I set off on a hike that I never finished. The road since then has taken me to unexpected places, but each passing year reminds me I've taken a farther step from that trauma. Read my piece 'On the Anniversary of Your Rape' ✍️ #MeToo #VAWG
https://t.co/WwRytaNW9r https://t.co/yBxR2HmGkN

And I'm looking forward to speaking with @RoehamptonUni students & staff this afternoon for Sexual Violence Awareness Month, along with @sam_thompson_uk @SurvivorsUK @RoehamptonSU 🙌 Events like these help survivors & victims find a supportive community, like @clearlinesuk #MeToo

I mean, is the Noel Clarke story all that surprising? ‘Man in the film industry uses his power & influence to bully & sexually harass women.’ Hmmm...  it’s about time some of these stories started coming out of the UK film industry. #MeToo #timesup
Same old story... just a new name this time. So tired of the systemic problems in an industry that enables this kind of behaviour. #MeToo #timesup

May is turning into a busy month for me! Catch me at one of these online events. I've enjoyed working with @clearlinesuk @shme_bbk @wowfest @NEXUS_NI @ArtsCouncilNI to widen the conversation about writing, sexual violence & survivorhood. #MeToo #endVAWG https://t.co/Aot6gMuS6Q

This afternoon I'll be giving a talk to @uniofglos Students' Union @yoursu about safety, sexual consent & gendered violence. Always a privilege to speak with students & advocates about creating positive change. #MeToo #endVAWG #BelieveSurvivors

'Horror rape' 🙄... well, if you read a few paragraphs into the story, you'll see a mention of our May 20th event at @NEXUS_NI @clearlinesuk - a powerful conversation with other authors on writing & the lived experience of sexual trauma #MeToo #believesurvivors #endVAWG
